references.text: Moses communicated all the Lord's words to the people, showing that God's commands were given through Moses' hand
The command to keep all the Lord's instructions that were given through Moses
The exhortation to keep all the words that the Lord has commanded for all generations
What is revealed belongs to us and our children forever, to keep all the words of this law
A statute for all generations (לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם), the same expression is used
The Sabbath as a sign through all generations (לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם)
An eternal statute for all generations in all their dwellings
Jesus commands the disciples to teach people to keep everything he has commanded them
